5251.commentary: (VBt) kāḷ'ānusārī'ti ekissā latāya mūlaṃ kira. mahākacchapena katapupphaṃ vā. (APt) kāḷavaṇṇaṃ anusarati sīlenā'ti kāḷ'ānusārī, kāḷavaṇṇajanakoty'attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, ye keci mūlagandhā, kāla-anusāri tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati… evam'eva bhoto gotamassa ovādo param'ajjadhammesu.

5253.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of anusāra (+instr)

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho kassapo devaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, bhikkhuṃ bhagavā pakāsesi, no ca bhikkhuno anusāsan'ti. tena hi kassapa, taññ'ev'ettha paṭibhātū'ti.

evam'etaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, hoti yesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ tādisā sabrahmacārino anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā. idañ'ca pana me āyasmato sāriputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttan'ti.
ovadeyya-anusāseyya, asabbhā ca nivāraye, satañ'hi so piyo hoti, asataṃ hoti appiyo.
ovadatu maṃ, bhante, bhagavā, anusāsatu maṃ, bhante, bhagavā, yaṃ mam'assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā'ti.
rājāno nāma pathabyārājā padesarājā maṇḍalikā antarabhogikā akkhadassā mah'āmattā, ye vā pana chejjabhejjaṃ karontā anusāsanti. ete rājāno nāma.

ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho, bho, jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ rājā disampati etadavoca, anusāsatu no bhavaṃ jotipālo, mā no bhavaṃ jotipālo anusāsaniyā paccabyāhāsi. pettike taṃ ṭhāne ṭhapessāmi, govindiye abhisiñcissāmī'ti.

jānāti, bhante, bhagavā paraṃ puggalaṃ paccattaṃ yonisomanasikārā, ayaṃ puggalo yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatī'ti. etadānuttariyaṃ, bhante, anusāsanavidhāsu.

sampādeth'appamādena, esā me anusāsanī, hand'āhaṃ parinibbissaṃ, vippamutto'mhi sabbadhī'ti.
sato, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sampajāno kālaṃ āgameyya. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī.

5270.meaning2: miracle of instruction; wonder of teaching

examples.text: idha, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu evam'anusāsati, evaṃ vitakketha, mā evaṃ vitakkayittha, evaṃ manasikarotha, mā evaṃ manasākattha, idaṃ pajahatha, idaṃ upasampajja viharathā'ti. idaṃ vuccati, kevaṭṭa, anusāsanīpāṭihāriyaṃ.
adaṇḍena asatthena, vijeyya pathaviṃ imaṃ, asāhasena kammena, samena anusāsi taṃ, dhammena rajjaṃ kāretvā, asmiṃ pathavimaṇḍale.

5273.commentary: (THIa) yathā maṃ anusāsi sā'ti sā therī yathā maṃ anusāsi ovadi, tathā paṭipajjantī paṭipattiṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā'pi satt'āhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdiṃ.

examples.text: tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvāna, yathā maṃ anusāsi sā, satt'āhaṃ ekapallaṅkena, nisīdiṃ pītisukhasamappitā, aṭṭhamiyā pāde pasāresiṃ, tamokhandhaṃ padāliyā'ti.

abhibhū hi so anabhibhūto, sakkhidhammam'anītiham'adassī, tasmā hi tassa bhagavato sāsane, appamatto sadā namassam'anusikkhe'ti.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, mahārāja, idh'ekacco puggalo akusalaṃ kammaṃ cetanāya cetayitvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyya. ye'pi tassa anusikkhanti, te'pi kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.

5292.commentary: (MNa) idham'anusikkhato'ti imasmiṃ sāsane sikkhantassa te tayo'pi kilesā antarāyakarā honti.

examples.text: etth'ete pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhā'pi byāpādā'pi sārambhā'pi saṃvattanti. t'eva ariyasāvakassa idha'm'anusikkhato antarāyāya sambhavanti.

examples.text: tesaṃ'y'eva kho pana, bhikkhave, mahānāgānaṃ anusikkhamānā taruṇā bhiṅkacchāpā taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā na suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā sakaddamaṃ asaṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
tesaṃ'y'eva kho pana, bhikkhave, therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anusikkhamānā navā bhikkhū pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisanti. te tattha dhammaṃ bhāsanti.
sadā jāgaramānānaṃ, ahoratta-anusikkhinaṃ, nibbānaṃ adhimuttānaṃ, atthaṃ gacchanti āsavā.
kusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ sukhavipākan'ti, ten'eva tvaṃ, rāhula, pītipāmojjena vihareyyāsi ahoratta-anusikkhī kusalesu dhammesu.

evaṃ vutte, bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, aho buddho, aho dhammo, aho dhammassa svākkhātatā! yatra hi nāma sāyam'anusiṭṭho pāto visesaṃ adhigamissati, pātam'anusiṭṭho sāyaṃ visesaṃ adhigamissatī'ti!

5297.commentary: (BVa) ovādan'ti sakiṃ vādo ovādo nāma. anusiṭṭhin'ti punappunaṃ vacanaṃ anusiṭṭhi nāma. (NIDD1a) anusiṭṭhin'ti anusāsaniṃ.

examples.text: tass'āhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, anusiṭṭhiṃ janettiyā, dhammasaṃvegam'āpādiṃ, yogakkhemassa pattiyā.
ovādaṃ anusiṭṭhiñ'ca, datvāna sesake jane, hut'āsano'va tāpetvā, nibbuto so sasāvako.
